messages.content: who sang a whiter shade of pale first

message.content:
**Procol Harum** first sang/recorded **“A Whiter Shade of Pale”** as their debut single in 1967.[1][2]

If you mean the **lead singer**, it was **Gary Brooker** of Procol Harum.[1][5]
